formula: For each token/channel x in R4: relu(x @ Win.T) @ Wout.T + original H_post * original branch output
sharing: Win[16,4]/Wout[4,16] shared across all channels/tokens; independent at each attention/MLP sublayer
init: Win=[I;-I;Q;-Q],Wout=0.5[I,-I,Q.T,-Q.T],Q orthogonal signed Hadamard with nonzero row sums; mathematical identity, no runtime alpha or bypass
read_write: Original NVIDIA H_pre/H_post and final collapse; branch pre-norm,full causal attention, hardware-selected FA3/FA2,original ReLU-squared backbone MLP unchanged
precision: BF16 activations; tiny mixer arithmetic/weights/reductions FP32,matching existing routing precision
kernel: Fused Triton MLP+write,hand backward,recompute16hidden,no saved hidden bank; deterministic partial weight reduction
optimizer: All connector parameters including tiny mixer use existing connector AdamW at unembedding LR/noWD; backbone MuonAdamW unchanged

gate.logging: local only,no credentials or weights returned
gate.hardware: Hopper/FA3/TMA or A100/FA2/non-TMA; keep allocated A100 gate7825044.0 on immutable7daac76 source

formal_training.attention: hardware_auto: Hopper pinnedFA3; A100 PyTorch2.10 FA2 only
formal_training.hardware_preflight: Each backend once:12 checks and4 full-batch finite updates, separate process/no W&B/no weights; restore marker on resume
formal_training.resume: Persist hardware_auto policy; record actual backend each start, restore optimizer/RNG/data/run ID across GPU families; numerical path may differ

limits: Shared nonlinear stream map is not independent learned parameters per channel; no direct cross-channel or cross-token mixing. Short gate does not guarantee long-term stability/quality.
supersedes: A100-only scheduling superseded by combined Hopper-or-A100 requirements; allocated A100 validation job retained; no duplicate experiment
